summary: Candidate is a distinct session_skill for Spring WebFlux trailing slash configuration during Spring Boot 3.0 migration. It differs semantically and structurally from peer candidate (Spring MVC variant) by targeting WebFluxConfigurer instead of WebMvcConfigurer. Peer candidates represent framework-specific implementations of the same objective but are separate skills. Existing skills in registry are unrelated (Flink watermarks, link prefetching). Evidence supports the capability but notes it as a temporary compatibility measure; this is appropriate guidance for a migration-specific skill. No merge, split, or revision relationship exists.
